# Audio fixtures

16 kHz, mono, 16-bit PCM WAV clips used by `tests/test_stt.py` and `scripts/bench_stt.py`.
Expected text for each clip is in `transcripts.json`.

They were synthesised with the Windows "Microsoft Hazel Desktop" (en-GB) SAPI voice, so they
contain no real person's voice. To add one, keep the same format and add its transcript.
